attributes.title: SkiCE 2027: A Focus on Feline Medicine
attributes.summary:
SkiCE 2027 is the Colorado VMA's winter retreat at Kindred Resort in Keystone, Colorado, from January 24 to 27, 2027. This year's program is devoted to feline medicine and totals 12 CE hours.

There is a dedicated technician rate: $545 through the early-bird deadline of November 13, 2026, then $645. CVMA members pay $645/$745, members of other VMAs or AAHA $675/$775, and non-members $1,015/$1,115. Rooms in the CVMA block start at $459 per night and must be booked by December 28, 2026.

The page does not state RACE approval or a separate technician track; the same 12 hours are offered to all registrants.
